title: Đây là trường hợp khẩn cấp
pronunciation: day la troong hop khun kup
summary: Different ways to say "This is an emergency" in Vietnam, with the phrase to start with, useful forms, and related next steps.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Đây là trường hợp khẩn cấp answers the traveler question "This is an emergency" in police, ambulance, hospitals, passports, and immediate safety. This is for when the first thing people need to know is that the situation is urgent. Its job is naming the concrete item or problem first so staff can choose the next action. The forms below show how tone, setting, or politeness changes the best choice.
